arguments.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shlex, signal, subprocess, time
source=pathlib.Path('scripts/conversation-qualification/diagnostic-readonly-inventory.py').read_bytes()
pin='1596be6da3d38772b772f8f81bcde4dfb50c33146018860dd494b74ea07e5ace'
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==pin
flags=['-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UpdateHostKeys=no','-o','ConnectTimeout=8','-o','ConnectionAttempts=1']
proxy=['ssh','-i',os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/beget_deploy'),*flags,'-W','%h:%p','mocine3388@prime.beget.com']
cmd=['ssh','-i',os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/yandex_bot'),*flags,'-o','ProxyCommand='+shlex.join(proxy),'botadmin@api.mayaos.ru','python3 - --collect']
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/maya-diagnostic-inventory-20261007')
root.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
start=time.time()
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,start_new_session=True)
try:
    out,err=p.communicate(source,timeout=620)
    status='completed'
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    try: out,err=p.communicate(timeout=3)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        out,err=p.communicate()
    status='timeout'
(root/'stdout.json').write_bytes(out)
(root/'ssh-stderr.txt').write_bytes(err)
receipt={'status':status,'exitCode':p.returncode,'seconds':round(time.time()-start,3),'collectorSha256':pin,'target':'botadmin@api.mayaos.ru','remoteCommand':'python3 - --collect','stdoutBytes':len(out),'stderrBytes':len(err),'evidenceDirectory':str(root)}
(root/'transport-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))
